metadata.question: Did Sierra Estrella show higher land surface temperature than PHX Airport in July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 (surface temperature ST_B10) on 2023-07-19 over union of Sierra Estrella and PHX Airport. If none, widen to ±1 day, then ±3 days. If still none, fallback to MODIS Terra MOD11A1 daily LST with same windows.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Landsat: Use QA_PIXEL to mask clouds, cirrus, shadow, dilated clouds; ensure ST_B10 > 0. Convert ST_B10 to Kelvin via scale 0.00341802 and offset 149.0.
- MODIS: Use QC_Day bits 0-1 <= 1 for good quality; mask LST_Day_1km == 0; scale 0.02 to Kelvin.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size is 0 after recovery attempts: C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 in either ROI: C2.
- If means are null or outside [200K, 400K]: C3.
- Else compare means: if Sierra Estrella LST > PHX LST => A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to await getInfo/evaluate
  const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
    });
  });

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const sierraEstrella = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-112.35, 33.15, -112.20, 33.28]); // Sierra Estrella range approx
    const phxAirport = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-112.05, 33.41, -111.98, 33.46]); // PHX Sky Harbor area
    const unionGeom = sierraEstrella.union(phxAirport, 1);

    const windows = [
      {start: '2023-07-19', end: '2023-07-20', label: 'D0'},
      {start: '2023-07-18', end: '2023-07-20', label: '±1d'},
      {start: '2023-07-16', end: '2023-07-22', label: '±3d'}
    ];

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function maskLandsatL2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const maskBits = ee.Number(1).leftShift(1) // dilated
        .add(ee.Number(1).leftShift(2))         // cirrus
        .add(ee.Number(1).leftShift(3))         // cloud
        .add(ee.Number(1).leftShift(4));        // cloud shadow
      const clear = qa.bitwiseAnd(maskBits).eq(0);
      const st = img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).rename('LST'); // Kelvin
      return st.updateMask(clear).updateMask(st.gt(0));
    }

    function landsatCollection(start, end, geom) {
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).select(['ST_B10', 'QA_PIXEL']);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end).select(['ST_B10', 'QA_PIXEL']);
      return l8.merge(l9);
    }

    function modisCollection(start, end, geom) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end)
        .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']);
    }

    let datasetUsed = null;
    let windowUsed = null;
    let lstImage = null;

    // Try Landsat windows
    for (const w of windows) {
      const col = landsatCollection(w.start, w.end, unionGeom);
      const size = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (size > 0) {
        // Build composite LST
        const lstCol = col.map(maskLandsatL2);
        // Median composite within window
        const comp = lstCol.median().rename('LST');
        // Check if comp has any pixels over union
        const validCount = await getInfo(comp.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: unionGeom,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('LST'));
        console.log(`Landsat L2 Images (${w.label} ${w.start}→${w.end}): ${size}`);
        if (validCount && validCount > 0) {
          datasetUsed = 'Landsat L2';
          windowUsed = `${w.start}→${w.end}`;
          lstImage = comp;
          break;
        } else {
          console.log(`Landsat valid pixels over union: ${validCount || 0}`);
        }
      } else {
        console.log(`Landsat L2 Images (${w.label} ${w.start}→${w.end}): 0`);
      }
    }

    // Fallback to MODIS if needed
    if (!lstImage) {
      for (const w of windows) {
        const col = modisCollection(w.start, w.end, unionGeom);
        const size = await getInfo(col.size());
        if (size > 0) {
          const lstCol = col.map(img => {
            const good = img.select('QC_Day').bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1);
            const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).rename('LST'); // Kelvin
            return lst.updateMask(good).updateMask(lst.gt(0));
          });
          const comp = lstCol.median();
          const validCount = await getInfo(comp.reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: unionGeom,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e9
          }).get('LST'));
          console.log(`MODIS MOD11A1 Images (${w.label} ${w.start}→${w.end}): ${size}`);
          if (validCount && validCount > 0) {
            datasetUsed = 'MODIS MOD11A1';
            windowUsed = `${w.start}→${w.end}`;
            lstImage = comp;
            break;
          } else {
            console.log(`MODIS valid pixels over union: ${validCount || 0}`);
          }
        } else {
          console.log(`MODIS MOD11A1 Images (${w.label} ${w.start}→${w.end}): 0`);
        }
      }
    }

    if (!lstImage) {
      console.log('No images found for any dataset/window.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    } else {
      console.log(`Dataset Used: ${datasetUsed} (${windowUsed})`);
    }

    // 3. Processing: Pixel counts to detect C2
    const scaleEval = datasetUsed.startsWith('MODIS') ? 1000 : 1000;

    const totalCountSE = await getInfo(ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: sierraEstrella,
      scale: scaleEval,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant')) || 0;

    const totalCountPHX = await getInfo(ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: phxAirport,
      scale: scaleEval,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant')) || 0;

    const validCountSE = await getInfo(lstImage.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: sierraEstrella,
      scale: scaleEval,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST')) || 0;

    const validCountPHX = await getInfo(lstImage.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: phxAirport,
      scale: scaleEval,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST')) || 0;

    if (validCountSE === 0 || validCountPHX === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid Pixels - Sierra Estrella: ${validCountSE}/${totalCountSE} (${(totalCountSE? (100*validCountSE/totalCountSE):0).toFixed(1)}%)`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels - PHX: ${validCountPHX}/${totalCountPHX} (${(totalCountPHX? (100*validCountPHX/totalCountPHX):0).toFixed(1)}%)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: Mean LST for both ROIs
    const meanSE_K = await getInfo(lstImage.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: sierraEstrella,
      scale: scaleEval,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST'));

    const meanPHX_K = await getInfo(lstImage.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: phxAirport,
      scale: scaleEval,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LST'));

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v) || v < 200 || v > 400);
    if (invalid(meanSE_K) || invalid(meanPHX_K)) {
      console.log(`LST Sierra Estrella (K): ${meanSE_K}, PHX (K): ${meanPHX_K}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const meanSE_C = meanSE_K - 273.15;
    const meanPHX_C = meanPHX_K - 273.15;

    console.log(`Valid Pixels - Sierra Estrella: ${validCountSE}/${totalCountSE} (${(100*validCountSE/totalCountSE).toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels - PHX: ${validCountPHX}/${totalCountPHX} (${(100*validCountPHX/totalCountPHX).toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`LST Sierra Estrella: ${meanSE_C.toFixed(2)} °C`);
    console.log(`LST PHX Airport: ${meanPHX_C.toFixed(2)} °C`);
    console.log(`Difference (SE - PHX): ${(meanSE_C - meanPHX_C).toFixed(2)} °C`);

    if (meanSE_K > meanPHX_K) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
